summary: Full backend + frontend acceptance run for the iteration_81 batch (4688 normalizer, tenant-scoped queue, evidence-inspector honesty, graph relationship grammar, dark/light theme, canvas navigation, priority ladder). BACKEND: existing modules re-run cleanly — test_phase2_telemetry_normalization + test_phase2_1_field_normalization_adversarial + test_p0_3_windows_logon_coverage = 34/34; test_xdr_mss = 12/12; test_xdr_dashboard = 20/20; test_xdr_incident_queue = 17/17. Added new module tests/test_iteration_81_review.py covering honest-empty-state, assignment filter (bogus→400), tenant scope, evidence-inspector action availability, attack-graph payload shape → 9 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed. FRONTEND (live preview, admin login): (1) [data-testid=xdr-shell] carries data-nx-theme=dark by default; [data-testid=xdr-theme-toggle] switches to light, localStorage.nx.theme='light', reload persists as light, toggle back returns to dark. (2) Incident queue shows 198 rows (All 198), priority chips per-rank distinct: P1 rgb(239,68,68), P2 rgb(234,88,12), P3 rgb(202,138,4), P5 rgb(100,116,139); each chip carries a rank glyph (▰▰▰▰/▰▰▰▱/▰▰▱▱/▱▱▱▱P#) so rank is not colour-only; ?priority=P1 filter renders 2 P1 rows in dark red rgb(239,68,68). (3) Attack Graph on inc_2c49c811268f41378b6a → Activity Graph: 4 visible edges (5/36 nodes, 4/23 edges after default layer filter) — for each DOM edge, data-edge-class equals the grammar-derived class from the API (OBSERVED w/1 ref → OBSERVED, OBSERVED w/≥2 refs → SUPPORTED, SUPPORTED → INFERRED, POSSIBLE → POSSIBLE, NOT_OBSERVED → GAP); 0 class mismatches, 0 direction mismatches; NO amber #fbbf24 glowing strokes anywhere on visible edges. (4) Canvas navigation: viewBox = '0 0 1180 560' initial → drag pans (viewBox x/y changes to -248 -110) → xdr-ag-nav-zoom-in scales to 1026x486 → mouse wheel is IGNORED (viewBox unchanged after -800 delta) → xdr-ag-nav-fit sets -24 -24 805 382 → xdr-ag-nav-reset returns to 0 0 1180 560 → keyboard ArrowRight/Down pans, '+' zooms. (5) Evidence Inspector — actions correctly attributed: IP-node inspector shows network_pivot + ioc_pivot both data-action-available='false', disabled, cursor:not-allowed, '⊘ CAPABILITY UNAVAILABLE' text; signature node shows detection_intel data-action-available='true', clickable; event/incident nodes render no action buttons (no fabricated capabilities). (6) Narrative rail lists 4 steps matching API graph.timeline length 4. (7) Metrics toggle collapsed by default (aria-expanded='false') → expands to 'true' on click. NO console errors on any tested surface.
critical_code_review_comments: AttackGraphTab.jsx continues to grow past the 700-line guideline (was flagged in iter_80 too). Consider extracting the SVG canvas, camera controller, narrative rail, and inspector-action button set into separate components.

GET /api/incidents default pagination cap is 100; the 'return all 198' rule only holds when caller passes limit large enough. If the UI relies on the total, the response already provides count=198 in the queue payload — front-end paginator should page through, not depend on limit=1000. Not a regression, just a callout.

One backend test module ordering issue: when test_xdr_dashboard and test_xdr_mss and test_xdr_incident_queue run together in one pytest process, 3 cross-module assertions become order-sensitive (state leakage between admin seeds). Individually each module is 12/12, 20/20, 17/17. Fix later by resetting the customer scope before test_tile_count_matches_queue_count and test_kpi_counts_match_incidents_queue.

success_rate.backend: 100% (all four in-scope modules pass individually + new module 9/9 non-skipped)
